LanguageData.LP_EttinCore.label: ettin origin
LanguageData.LP_EttinCore.description: The ettin bloodline, inheritable. Body size 2.0 (drawn about 1.4×), two heads side by side on the shoulders (losing one head isn't fatal, see "lone head"); robust build, move speed 4.0, learning ×85%, stomach ×180%. This gene makes them count as giants: rank 5 of the ordning (below frost giants), can wear giant-only apparel and wield giant-only weapons, and don't care about nudity.
LanguageData.LP_EttinCore.customEffectDescriptions.0: Giant lineage: ettin (rank 5 of the ordning, below frost giants).
LanguageData.LP_EttinCore.customEffectDescriptions.1: Body size 2.0 (drawn about 1.4×), children grow with age; two heads (the second head is cosmetic; when the main head takes a lethal wound, it takes over, granting "lone head").
LanguageData.LP_EttinCore.customEffectDescriptions.2: No negative mood from nudity; can wear ordinary clothes; each piece of giant-only apparel gives mood +2 (up to +6).
LanguageData.LP_EttinCore.modExtensions.0.label: ettin
LanguageData.LP_EttinWatch.label: taking turns at watch
LanguageData.LP_EttinWatch.description: Requires two heads. While one head sleeps, the other stays awake: sleep need fall rate ×50%; wakes at once when enemies appear within 10 cells during sleep. Has no effect with only one head (or when on someone with only one head).
LanguageData.LP_EttinWatch.customEffectDescriptions.0: Requires two heads (no effect on humans; stops working after losing one head).
LanguageData.LP_EttinWatch.customEffectDescriptions.2: Wakes at once when enemies come within 10 cells while asleep (checked every 250 ticks).
LanguageData.LP_EttinTwinGrip.label: ambidextrous
LanguageData.LP_EttinTwinGrip.description: Requires two heads each controlling one hand: only works for those with the ettin origin, with both hands usable. The best melee weapon in the pack serves as the off-hand; while the main hand holds a melee weapon or is empty, each normal melee hit is followed by an off-hand strike (damage per the mod setting "off-hand follow-up damage", 50% by default, same as mariliths).
LanguageData.LP_EttinTwinGrip.customEffectDescription: Requires two heads each controlling one hand (needs the ettin origin), with both hands usable.
Off-hand: the 1 melee weapon in the pack with the highest quality × DPS.
After a normal melee hit, the off-hand follows up with one strike; doesn't trigger when the main hand holds a ranged weapon or on ability hits.
LanguageData.LP_EttinQuarrel.label: two-headed discord
LanguageData.LP_EttinQuarrel.description: Neither head yields to the other. During a minor mental break they may fall into "infighting": standing in place arguing for 1 hour, doing no work; also about every 15 days there's a 10% chance they start arguing on their own (not when mood is above 70%). Needs two heads to argue.
LanguageData.LP_EttinQuarrel.customEffectDescriptions: Minor mental breaks gain one more type, "infighting" (as common as "sad wander"): arguing in place for 1 hour, doing no work.
Every 15 days, a 10% chance to start arguing on its own; not when mood is above 70% or asleep.
Requires two heads (no more arguing after losing one).
LanguageData.LP_SkinEttinGrey.label: grey-brown skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinEttinGrey.description: An ettin's rough grey-brown skin, like weathered mountain rock.
LanguageData.LP_SkinEttinOchre.label: ochre skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinEttinOchre.description: An ettin's ochre skin, like sun-dried clay.
LanguageData.LP_CyclopsCore.label: cyclops origin
LanguageData.LP_CyclopsCore.description: The cyclops bloodline, inheritable. Body size 1.8 (drawn about 1.35×), one big eye in the middle of the forehead (the two eye parts together make up this single eye: if either is damaged, sight takes the worst; without it they're blind); robust build, move speed 4.2, learning ×85%, stomach ×170%. This gene makes them count as giants: rank 6 of the ordning (below ettins), can wear giant-only apparel and wield giant-only weapons, and don't care about nudity. That big eye isn't afraid of being stared down: gaze effects like a lich's fear gaze don't work on them.
Giant lineage: cyclops (rank 6 of the ordning, below ettins).
Body size 1.8 (drawn about 1.35×), children grow with age; one eye: sight takes the worst of the two eye parts.
Immune to gaze effects (lich fear gaze, scroll of fearful gaze, etc.).
No negative mood from nudity; can wear ordinary clothes; each piece of giant-only apparel gives mood +2 (up to +6).
LanguageData.LP_CyclopsCore.modExtensions.0.label: cyclops
LanguageData.LP_CyclopsCraft.label: cyclops craftsmanship
LanguageData.LP_CyclopsCraft.description: Cyclopes are born craftsmen: construction speed +20%; work speed at the smithy and rune anvil (smithing recipes) +15%.
LanguageData.LP_CyclopsShepherd.label: herder
LanguageData.LP_CyclopsShepherd.description: Cyclopes are patient herders: taming and training success and animal gathering (milking, shearing) yield +25%. Mood +2 when the colony keeps sheep or goats (the flock).
LanguageData.LP_CyclopsShepherd.customEffectDescripti: Colony has sheep or goats: mood +2 (the flock).
LanguageData.LP_CyclopsFlatSight.label: monocular vision
LanguageData.LP_CyclopsFlatSight.description: With only one eye, depth perception is poor: shooting accuracy -3.5 points (vanilla accuracy points; at Shooting 10 and 20 cells, hit chance about ×70%), ranged aiming time +10%.
LanguageData.LP_SkinCyclopsRuddy.label: russet skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinCyclopsRuddy.description: A cyclops's skin baked reddish-brown by forge fires.
LanguageData.LP_SkinCyclopsOlive.label: olive skin
